description: Demo control panel. A trigger button (accessible name from openLabel, plus the network name when given) opens a Dialog titled "Demo controls". Each toggle is a Radix Switch (role="switch", aria-checked) labelled by a Label via htmlFor and described by its hint via aria-describedby. Reset is two steps: the Reset button swaps in a labelled group with a confirm question, a destructive confirm (autofocused) and Cancel. Confirming calls onReset and closes the dialog. The trigger's live and warning dots are decorative.

keyboard.action: Cycles through the switches, extra toggles, Reset (or confirm/cancel) and the close button.
Closes the dialog and abandons a pending reset confirmation.

focus.notes: Radix traps focus and returns it to the trigger on close. Clicking Reset moves focus to the confirm button; Cancel returns focus to Reset.

announcements: Each switch is announced with its label, hint and on/off state.
The reset confirmation is a group named by its question.
screenReader.notes: The warning dot on the trigger only signals an armed fault visually. If that matters, include it in openLabel (e.g. "Demo controls, failure armed").

contrast.text: Labels use foreground, hints use text-muted-foreground on bg-popover; both meet WCAG AA
contrast.ui: Switch and Button use the shared ring-3 ring-ring/50 focus ring; the checked switch uses bg-primary

motion.reducedMotion: Inherits Dialog's fade + zoom and Switch's thumb transition.

consumerResponsibilities: Pass all labels in the page language; defaults are English.
Keep slow/failNext in your own state and update them from onSlowChange/onFailNextChange.
Use DemoControlsToggle for extra toggles so they get the same labelling.
Confirm the reset outcome yourself (e.g. a toast) after onReset runs.
